description: Repair an old or damaged photo: remove scratches, dust, creases and fading, recover sharp faces, keep everyone exactly as they are. Optionally colorize a black-and-white photo. Costs credits. Returns the restored image (or pending → get_image). Tip: animate the result with animate_photo afterwards.

colorize.description: Also colorize a black-and-white or sepia photo. Default false.

image_url.description: Public https URL of the old photo (a scan or phone photo of a print is fine).

name: restore_photo
title: Restore an old photo
